narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same life. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} came apart first, that same month: how much of each salary was claimed before it arrived. In month {layoff_month} the layoff reached you both, and the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. In month {widest_gap_month} the money stood furthest apart, with the ghost holding {widest_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}.
